subject: Portal payment display issue
text: We need support with the registration portal before Friday’s community fair. During the last test, some attendee profiles saved with blank payment fields, while confirmation emails still showed “paid.” I cannot confirm how many records were affected, and the error does not appear on the admin dashboard. I also have a scheduling conflict: I must leave the office at two for the venue walkthrough, so troubleshooting may need to happen in a short window beforehand. If you can run diagnostics, let me know whether a patch can be applied before noon. If not, send a workaround that lets staff manually correct payment statuses and resend receipts without breaking QR codes. Please also advise whether exported CSVs will match corrections immediately, because printed badges depend on that data. If access is required, I can temporarily assign you elevated permissions. I can share logs after the walkthrough, unless you prefer a screen recording tonight. I value clear updates and can answer questions by text between sessions within ten minutes if needed.
